title: The Outsiders
author: S. E. Hinton
summary: Fourteen-year-old Ponyboy belongs to the Greasers, a group of working-class boys who clash with the wealthy Socs. A violent night forces him and his brothers to face what their loyalty costs.
readIf: you want a short, emotional story about brotherhood and class divides.
skipIf: you dislike dated slang or stories where teenage violence ends in tragedy.

pairings.reason: Another teen classic about belonging, with a quieter, more introspective tone.
A short, fast novel with a young hero facing something much bigger than himself.
A newer novel about a teen caught between two worlds and the violence in her community.
